### Key Statistics
- **Target**: 60% | **Best achieved**: 49% (iter_02) | **Gap**: 11 points
- **Successful optimization rounds**: 1 (iter_02, +9 points from baseline)
- **P0 gate failures**: 7 out of 8 optimization attempts
- **Catastrophic regressions**: 1 (iter_09, 26%)
- **Full eval runs completed**: 4 out of 10 iterations (iter_01, 02, 04, 09)

### Root Cause Analysis
1. **IG_abacus_002 fragility**: Regressed in every optimization attempt as a P0 sentinel — inherently unstable at the k=3 "all-pass" threshold
2. **Cross-domain skill coupling**: Modifying any SKILL.md file consistently causes unintended side effects on other domains
3. **Optimization agent approach**: The skill-editing strategy proved unable to make targeted improvements without collateral damage
4. **P0 gate sensitivity**: With 9 P0 questions and a strict "no regression" gate, even natural variance on unstable P0 questions (IG_abacus_002, BP_struct_003) blocks progress

### What Worked
- Iter_02 optimization (+9 points) successfully improved ABACUS input generation and band property skills
- Polymer tasks (5/5), direct WO tasks (3/3), and core DF/SC tasks were reliably stable at baseline

### What Didn't Work
- Every attempt to further optimize after iter_02 caused P0 regressions
- The iter_09 catastrophic regression suggests accumulated skill-edit debt created structural fragility

### Recommendations for Future Sessions
1. **Fix IG_abacus_002 P0 classification**: It passes ~60-70% of runs but cannot sustain k=3 all-pass — either improve its stability or adjust its P0 status
2. **Additive-only optimization**: Only add NEW skill files/references/scripts; never modify existing SKILL.md files that touch passing questions
3. **Domain isolation**: Ensure ABACUS, structure construction, and workflow skills are fully decoupled so edits don't cascade
4. **Smaller k for P0 gate**: The k=3 all-pass requirement on inherently stochastic questions creates a high bar that blocks incremental improvement
